cards.h:
Thermal conductivity ( k ) of fluid between the slide surfaces. If a gap with a thickness L(gap) exists between the slide surfaces, then the conductance due to thermal conductivity between the slide surfaces is
H(cond) = K/L(gap), Note that LS- DYNA calculates L(gap) based on deformation.
cards.localized: 滑动表面之间流体的热导率 k。若两滑动表面之间存在厚度为 L(gap) 的间隙，则由流体导热产生的热导为 H(cond) = K/L(gap)。注意，LS-DYNA 根据变形计算 L(gap)。

cards.h: Radiation factor, f, between the slide surfaces.
cards.localized: 滑动表面之间的辐射因子 f。

cards.h: Heat transfer conductance for closed gaps, used when 0 <= L(gap) <= LMIN.
cards.localized: 闭合间隙的传热系数，适用于 0 <= L(gap) <= LMIN。

cards.h: Minimum gap thickness. H0 applies below this value. If LMIN < 0, -LMIN is the load curve ID defining the minimum gap as a function of time.
cards.localized: 最小间隙厚度。间隙厚度小于该值时使用 H0。LMIN < 0 时，-LMIN 为载荷曲线 ID，用于定义最小间隙随时间的变化。

cards.h: maximum length, no thermal contact if gap thickness is greater than this value.
cards.localized: 最大长度，若间隙厚度大于该值则视为无热接触。

cards.h:
Fraction,  f, of sliding friction energy partitioned to the SURFA surface (see Remark 3). Energy partitioned to the SURFB surface is (1-f).
EQ.0:    Set to 0.5 (default). The sliding friction energy is partitioned 50 % -50 % to the SURFA and SURFB surfaces in contact.
cards.localized:
分配到 SURFA 表面的滑动摩擦能量比例 f（参见备注 3）。分配到 SURFB 表面的能量比例为 1 − f。
EQ.0：设为 0.5（默认值），滑动摩擦能量在接触的 SURFA 与 SURFB 表面之间各分配 50%。

cards.h:
Thermal boundary condition flag
EQ.0: thermal boundary conditions are ON when parts are in contact
EQ.1: thermal boundary conditions are OFF when parts are in contact
cards.localized:
热边界条件标志
EQ.0：部件发生接触时，热边界条件处于开启状态。
EQ.1：部件发生接触时，热边界条件处于关闭状态。

cards.h:
Thermal contact algorithm type.
EQ.0: Two-way contact. Both surfaces change temperature due to contact
EQ.1: One-way contact. The surface of SURFB does not change temperature due to contact. The surface of SURFA does change temperature.
EQ.2: Two-way edge contact
EQ.3: One-way edge contact(no heat transfer into reference side)
NOTE: For ALGO = 2 and 3, shell edges must be on the SURFA side, and solid facets and shell surface need to be on the SURFB side.
cards.localized:
热接触算法类型：
EQ.0：双向接触，两个表面都会因接触改变温度。
EQ.1：单向接触，SURFB 表面不因接触改变温度，SURFA 表面会改变温度。
EQ.2：双向边缘接触。
EQ.3：单向边缘接触（参考侧无热传递）。
注意：ALGO = 2 或 3 时，壳边缘必须位于 SURFA 侧，实体面和壳表面必须位于 SURFB 侧。

cards.h: Load curve ID defining the static friction coefficient as a function of temperature. The curve value multiplies FS.
cards.localized: 载荷曲线 ID，用于定义静摩擦系数随温度的变化；曲线值与 FS 相乘。

cards.h: Load curve ID defining the dynamic friction coefficient as a function of temperature. The curve value multiplies FD.
cards.localized: 载荷曲线 ID，用于定义动摩擦系数随温度的变化；曲线值与 FD 相乘。

cards.h:
Formula that defines the contact heat conductance as a function of temperature and pressure.
If FORMULA < 0, supply |FORMULA| real user-subroutine parameters on additional cards, eight parameters per card.
cards.localized:
用于定义接触热导随温度与压力变化的公式。
FORMULA < 0 时，在附加卡片上输入 |FORMULA| 个实数用户子程序参数，每张卡片最多 8 个参数。

cards.h: Load curve number for the a coefficient used in the formula
cards.localized: 公式中 a 系数所对应的载荷曲线编号。

cards.h: Load curve number for the b coefficient used in the formula
cards.localized: 公式中 b 系数所对应的载荷曲线编号。

cards.h: Load curve number for the c coefficient used in the formula
cards.localized: 公式中 c 系数所对应的载荷曲线编号。

cards.h: Load curve number for the d coefficient used in the formula
cards.localized: 公式中用于 d 系数的载荷曲线编号。

cards.h:
Load curve number for h. If this is defined, it will take precedence over any other defintions.
GT.0: function versus time,
GT.NLCUR: general function (time, temp, pressure, gap)
LT.0: function versus temperature.
cards.localized:
GT.0: function versus time,
GT.NLCUR: general function (time, temp, pressure, gap)
LT.0: function versus temperature.
h 的载荷曲线编号。如果定义，将优先于其他定义。
GT.0：函数随时间变化。
GT.NLCUR：通用函数（时间、温度、压力、间隙）。
LT.0：函数随温度变化。
